title: Questions 153-155 refer to the following e-mail.
passage_1:
To:Bernard Achebe <b.achebe@lindholmgroup.com>
From:Solveig Nyman <s.nyman@lindholmgroup.com>
Date:April 9
Subject:Proposal
Attachment:Floor_Sketches

Dear Mr. Achebe,

I am writing to propose that we turn the old archive room on the third floor into a quiet work space. At present the room is cluttered and poorly lit, which stops anyone from using it for work that needs concentration. – [1] –.

I suggest we create a calm, well-lit environment, much like a small reading room. We could clear out the disused cabinets, fit task lamps, and put acoustic panels on the walls. We could also bring in a few low armchairs and a rug. By making the room genuinely quiet, we can give staff somewhere to work without being interrupted. – [2] –.

I have attached a few possible layouts for your review. – [3] –. Please let me know what you think of the idea. – [4] –. I would be glad to meet and talk it through.

Best regards,

Solveig Nyman
Operations Coordinator
